meta.label: Export Adaptive Sheet
meta.description: Push rows from a Dataiku dataset back into a Workday Adaptive Planning sheet.

params.name: sheet
params.label: Target sheet
params.description: Loads dynamically from your Adaptive instance once credentials are set.

params.name: version
params.label: Adaptive version
params.description: Adaptive version name to write to. Leave empty to target the current working version.

params.name: mode
params.label: Write mode
params.description: Only honored for modeled sheets. Cube and standard imports follow Adaptive's additive merge semantics.

params.name: batch_size
params.label: Batch size
params.description: Rows per Adaptive API call. Lower this if you hit payload-size errors.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run
params.description: Validate and log batches without actually pushing to Adaptive.
